title: Morning rush in Bangkok: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Bangkok, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Bangkok city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: BTS, Blue Line, Purple Line, Pink Line, Yellow Line and Red/ARL, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 197 trains at 7:50 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out King Bhumibol Memorial Day (October 13), Bangkok special holiday (October 16) and Chulalongkorn Day (October 23).
